title: Welcome Guide
content:
Welcome to the Collaborative Real-Time Text Editor!

Multiple users can edit this document at the same time.
Features:
• Balanced AVL Rope data structure for high performance
• Operational Transformation (OT) for conflict-free real-time sync
• Live multi-user cursors and selection presence
• Full version history and snapshot time-travel
• Local Undo/Redo support
